meta.title: ResumeCraft AI — Resume and CV builder
meta.description: Build a clear, professional resume with 12 templates, live preview and PDF download. Your data stays in your browser.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be wrong, or the page has moved.

footer.tagline: A resume builder that keeps your work in your own browser.
footer.local: No account. Resumes are saved on this device.

export.title: Save your resume as a PDF
export.description: Your browser creates the file, so text stays sharp, selectable and correct in every language.
export.step1: In the print window, set “Destination” to “Save as PDF”.
export.step2: Check that the paper size is {size}. Leave margins on “Default” and scale on 100%.
export.step3: Turn “Headers and footers” off, then press Save.
export.browserNote: Chrome and Edge give the most accurate result. Other browsers may handle page size differently.
export.dontShow: Do not show these steps again
export.failed: The PDF could not be prepared. Please try again.

hero.title: Write a resume that is clear, honest and ready to send
hero.body: Choose a template, fill in your details and watch the pages update as you type. Download a PDF when it looks right.
hero.caption: Sample resumes with fictional details

featured.title: Start from a layout that suits the job
featured.intro: Each template is a different layout, not only a different colour. You can switch at any time without retyping.

choose.title: Choose a template
choose.body: Filter by style, photo support or compatibility with applicant tracking systems.

write.title: Add your details
write.body: Work through one section at a time. Changes save by themselves.

design.title: Adjust the look
design.body: Change colour, font, spacing and section order, with undo if you change your mind.

download.title: Download the PDF
download.body: Save an A4 or US Letter PDF with selectable text and working links.

methods.title: Two ways to begin
methods.intro: Both end in the same editor, so you can change anything afterwards.

manual.title: Write it yourself
manual.body: Pick a template and complete the sections in any order. Nothing leaves your device.

guided.title: Answer questions, get a draft
guided.body: Describe your background in your own words. The assistant arranges it into a draft for you to check and correct.

customise.title: Make it yours without breaking the layout
customise.intro: Controls stay within readable limits, so a change cannot easily ruin the page.
customise.type: Six font families, including Khmer support in each
customise.layout: Margins, spacing, page size and photo style
customise.order: Reorder, hide or add your own sections

assistant.title: Writing help when you want it
assistant.intro: The optional assistant uses Google Gemini. It proposes changes; you decide what stays.

summary.title: Summaries
summary.body: Three versions written from the experience you entered.

bullets.title: Experience points
bullets.body: Tighten wording, fix grammar or start with stronger verbs.

tailor.title: Job descriptions
tailor.body: See which requirements your resume shows and which it does not.

review.title: Review
review.body: Notes on clarity, missing details and repetition.

rules.invent: It is told never to invent jobs, qualifications or figures, and new numbers are rejected automatically
rules.approve: No change is applied until you accept it
rules.consent: You are asked before any text is sent

ats.title: Check how machine-readable it is
ats.intro: Many employers use applicant tracking systems that read resumes before a person does.
ats.text: Real text in the PDF, not pictures of text
ats.check: A built-in check for contact details, structure and job keywords
ats.disclaimer: The score is an estimate. Hiring systems differ, and no tool can guarantee that a resume will pass them.

free.q: Do I need to pay or sign up?
free.a: No. There are no accounts or payments in this app. AI features depend on the usage limits of the Gemini key the site is configured with.

storage.a: In this browser’s local database. Clearing browser data removes it, so export a backup file now and then.

devices.q: Can I continue on another device?
devices.a: Yes, by exporting a backup file here and importing it there. There is no automatic sync.

pdf.a: Your browser’s print window opens and you choose “Save as PDF”. This keeps Khmer and other scripts correct.

ai.q: What is sent to the AI?
ai.a: Only the text a request needs, and only after you agree. Your name, contact details, photo and references are not included in the resume text that is sent.

khmer.a: Yes. The interface and the resume headings are available in Khmer, and your own words are never translated automatically.

final.title: Ready to write yours?
final.body: Start now and come back to it whenever you like on this device.

privacy.local: Resumes, photos and preferences are stored in your browser. This app has no accounts and no resume database.
privacy.loss: Clearing site data, using a private window or losing the device removes your resumes. Keep a backup file.
privacy.aiSend: AI features need an internet connection. After you agree, the text for a request passes through this site’s server to Google Gemini, which processes it under Google’s terms. This app does not save or log that text.
privacy.noTracking: There are no advertising or analytics trackers, and resume data is never placed in cookies.
